title: DeepMisconceptionCodeSubmissionSchema
description: Schema for Modality 1: Python Source Code Submissions

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the programming session

scenario_family_id.description: Identifier for the scenario family group used for split stratification

concept_area.description: Primary concept domain (one of at least 35 concept areas)

problem_description.description: Specification and requirements of the programming problem

python_code.description: Complete Python source code submitted by the student

expected_behavior.description: Expected output and behavior according to problem specifications

actual_behavior.description: Actual observed output from executing code against test cases

code_correctness_status.description: Empirical correctness status based on execution outcomes

identified_code_issues.description: Description of any syntax, semantic, or conceptual errors in the code
